purpose: Define the next Foldseek-plus-geometry atlas feature lane for weak-Foldseek, near-orphan, fold-conflict, and OOS-router diagnostics before any larger representation model scaling.

decision_context.decision_gate: prioritize Foldseek-plus-geometry atlas/features and external/child-label acquisition before larger representation model scaling
basis: Near-orphan geometry rescue favored geometry: geometry 17/17, Foldseek 13/17 with 4 abstentions, ESM-2 150M 9/17 with 8 abstentions.
Wrong-Foldseek-transfer was the only cell with learned rescue signal: corrected ESM-C rescued 2/4, but geometry rescued 4/4.
Child-label and mixed-chemistry cells lack row-aligned child-label prediction exports, so model scaling would mostly test parent-bucket interpolation.
The active-site train/cal leakage audit passes, but supervised training remains blocked without explicit user approval.

clean_near_orphan_anchor.use: Review-only geometry-rescue anchor set for rows with weak or absent same-fingerprint structural neighborhood.

fold_conflict_reference_anchor.use: Review-only Foldseek wrong-transfer reference set; 217 and 477 are strongest verified anchors, 428 is partial/mixed-neighborhood.

oos_router_control.use: OOS abstention/router control set, including router-correct OOS-neighbor rows and weak-Foldseek noise rows.

local_tail_extension.use: Label-blind local-tail stress rows; canary diagnostics only, not performance evidence.

external_router_priority.use: External/router-priority active-site cache rows for source-diversity and OOD stress only.

quarantine_before_model_claim.use: Excluded from metric anchoring until label/coordinate/mechanism questions are resolved.

stage_1_foldseek_neighborhood.description: Compute structural neighborhood context without treating the nearest structure as ground truth.

stage_2_source_free_geometry.description: Summarize the local catalytic evidence that can rescue or reject structural-neighbor transfer without mechanism text leakage.

stage_3_policy_router.description: Route rows into review-only diagnostic cells before any benchmark claim or production use.

routes.condition: local geometry supports assigned parent mechanism and row is not quarantined
nearest structural neighbor points to a different primary fingerprint and geometry supports the row label or OOS status
row is OOS and nearest useful structural neighbor is OOS or Foldseek evidence is weak/noisy
row is external/local-tail stress without countable label support
label, coordinate, mechanism, or cofactor interpretation is unresolved
routes.allowed_use: manual dossier only; no metric anchoring

stage_4_evidence_dossier.description: Emit a per-row human-readable dossier that explains why a row is anchor, control, canary, or quarantine.

near_orphan_geometry_rescue.metric: count rows where local geometry provides the correct parent-v1 route when Foldseek has no reliable same-fingerprint neighbor

wrong_foldseek_transfer_rescue.metric: count rows where nearest structural transfer would be wrong but geometry routes correctly or abstains

oos_unsafe_nonabstention.metric: count OOS control rows where a router would emit an in-scope primary prediction without sufficient geometry support

local_tail_expected_pattern_failure.metric: count local-tail canaries that violate expected source-diversity/router behavior

implementation_notes.recommended_next_code_scope: read-only dossier compiler that joins existing Foldseek/TM, active-site cache, geometry summaries, and slice-contract row-use status
not_recommended_now: larger model leaderboard runs before child-label exports exist
registry or ontology edits from diagnostic rows
using quarantined rows as performance anchors
supervised active-site smoke without explicit user approval
implementation_notes.why_this_is_next: The current evidence says Foldseek-plus-local-geometry is the only decision-grade path in weak-Foldseek cells; learned representations remain secondary until child labels and external panels exist.

next_allowed_actions: Build a read-only Foldseek+geometry per-row dossier compiler.
Build the external/v2 acquisition priority pack for child labels and external stress panels.
